name: Read aloud (text to speech for any text)
description: Read any text aloud from anywhere in an app: ReadAloud.read(context, text) starts foreground playback (ReadAloudService, media playback) that keeps going after the caller closes, with notification controls (back, pause/resume, next, slower, faster, stop), audio focus (duck / pause others, pause / stop / keep on interruption, carry on afterwards), headphones-unplugged pause, screen-off stop, sleep timer, retries and a live state flow (queue, current piece, word being spoken, voices, engines). Pure-Kotlin rules other ports mirror: ReadAloudPrefs (54 preferences, every number clamped into ReadAloudRanges), TextPrep (links, emails, emoji, markdown, brackets, hashtags, abbreviations, ALL-CAPS spelling, digits, punctuation, spell-out, user pronunciations, length limit), TextChunker (sentence / clause / line / paragraph / fixed pieces with offsets and pauses, long pieces split on spaces, paragraph skips, time estimate, word at offset), ReadQueue (replace / append / play next, size cap, history, repeat). ReadAloudSettings.groups(prefix, tab, module) = nine generated settings groups any plugin reuses under its own key prefix. Harvested from the X Select plugin (Oct 24 2026).

params.label: Settings key prefix
params.help: Each app or plugin keeps its own copy of the read-aloud settings under its prefix.
